state_at_declaration.selection_basis: A non-adjacent standalone 12.12.x build predating every retained 12.13.9.1/12.13.10.3/12.13.11.1 row; selected before installation or any product-facing candidate run.

target_build.package_source: Chocolatey community package metadata naming Apple Inc. and an Apple secure-appldnld URL
target_build.lawful_provenance_boundary: Public Apple-hosted redistributable installer obtained through retained public package metadata; no proprietary installer or executable will be committed.

setup_and_positive_input_generation.classification: input generation, not an independent writer implementation and not a qualification cycle
setup_and_positive_input_generation.profile: fresh disposable junction with no XML, Previous iTunes Libraries, or pre-existing ITL
native_operations: controlled first launch/EULA and known-audio/update-modal handling
ordinary playlist creation and one-member insertion
setup_and_positive_input_generation.lock_requirement: The resulting exact ITL/media hashes, outer file PID, COM library PID, track PID, playlist PID, parser summary, and COM state must be retained and committed before qualification.

positive_qualification.input: the exact locked 12.12.10.1 native-authored one-track ITL
required_gates: two stable COM snapshots per cycle
separate outer file PID and COM library PID gates
worker and iTunes exit 0 after normal COM Quit

negative_qualification.reset_policy: Each attempt starts from a fresh copy of the identical pinned input, not from any prior attempt output.
negative_qualification.predeclared_product_gate: The structurally valid input reaches iTunes and is refused by a product-facing newer-library-version modal before COM semantic qualification.
required_gates: product-facing modal captured on both attempts
modal meaning identifies a library created by a newer iTunes version
no XML, Previous iTunes Libraries, damaged-library replacement, or fallback identity
normal dismissal/close and process exit without forced termination
negative_qualification.classification_if_gate_passes: structurally valid product-facing native semantic/version negative
negative_qualification.classification_if_gate_fails: predeclared negative did not reproduce; retain the result and do not substitute another candidate post hoc

claim_limits: The positive is native-authored and does not qualify an independent writer or arbitrary 12.12.10.1 edits.
The negative, if observed, is one exact newer-version input on one exact executable and is not universal backward-incompatibility.
Two repeated attempts/cycles are not independent experiments.
U-01, universal_itl_support, and the full-analysis/specification gate remain open/false.
